Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support prices.

Silver.note: Recent bearish momentum and softer industrial demand offset precious tailwinds.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate markets and robust green energy demand drive bullish outlook.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficits and renewed global nuclear capacity build-outs.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply and EV demand growth deceleration weigh on prices.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply growth outpaces sluggish stainless steel and battery demand.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge collapses and mine supply constraints tighten the market.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness caps upside despite resilient steel production.

Coal.note: Thermal coal faces long-term demand destruction while met coal remains rangebound.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic supply controls offset weak near-term EV and wind sector demand.

Manganese.note: Steady steel production provides a neutral baseline with no major supply shocks.

PGM.note: Weak automotive production and substitution effects offset supply constraints.

Potash.note: Global agricultural planting intentions remain firm following price normalization.

Aluminum.note: Yunnan hydro-power curtailments and strong solar demand tighten primary balances.

Diversified.note: Broad exposure balances copper upside against iron ore and nickel weakness.
